claim: SMART BOMB is the SBOMB routine; its first act is to load the SBFLG 'in progress' latch (LDA SBFLG) — a second press while it is set bails, so one press fires one bomb.
The smart-bomb stock is the per-player count PSBC,X (LDA PSBC,X); the following BEQ bails when it is zero, so a bomb only fires when one is held.
An empty smart-bomb stock branches out of SBOMB (BEQ SBMBX2 → JMP SUCIDE): no fire, no spend.
On fire the smart bomb arms its in-progress latch: INC SBFLG. Modelled as SmartBombResult.armed=true on a fire.
On fire the smart bomb spends exactly one bomb from the player's stock: DEC PSBC,X. Modelled as count-1 on a fire.
The smart-bomb clear gate tests each on-screen object's type against $02 (CMPA #$02); this is SMART_BOMB_CLEAR_TYPE_MAX.
Objects with OTYP at or above $02 are SPARED by the smart bomb (BHS SBMB2 skips them); objects below $02 are cleared via their collision vector [OCVECT,X]. clearsType(otyp) = otyp < $02.
The smart-bomb screen flash count is 4 (LDA #4 SCREEN FLASHES/2); SMART_BOMB_FLASHES. The TIMING is ported and cited; the strobe PRESENTATION is substituted per ADR-0005.

The smart-bomb flash is a whole-page colour-RAM inversion: SBMBX0 COM PCRAM. This full-screen strobe is the ADR-0005 exception — it is SUBSTITUTED by the df4-2 effect-policy (freeze/fade/particle), never ported as an inversion.
Hyperspace is refused unless STATUS masked by $FD is zero (BITA #$FD, followed by LBNE HYPX 'NO GO'); HYPER_NOGO_MASK. canHyperspace(status) = (status & $FD) == 0.
On entry hyperspace sets STATUS to $77 (LDA #$77 / STA STATUS); HYPER_STATUS, the in-hyperspace / re-entry marker.
Hyperspace naps 15 scheduler ticks before the jump (NAP 15,HYP02); HYPER_NAP. It is a df3 scheduler process, not a per-power rAF.
The random hyperspace DIRECTION is the SEED low bit shifted into carry (LSRB); the following BCC selects the branch. A random draw off the seeded rng, not Math.random.
Carry clear (SEED low bit 0) branches to HYP0 (BCC HYP0): the LEFT teleport (X=$7000, dir -$0300). Carry set falls through to the RIGHT teleport.
The RIGHT hyperspace teleport sets the player X to $2000 (LDD #$2000); HYPER_X_RIGHT.
The RIGHT hyperspace teleport faces the ship right at magnitude $0300 (LDX #$0300); HYPER_DIR_MAG. The LEFT branch uses its negation -$0300.
The LEFT hyperspace teleport (HYP0) faces the ship left at -$0300 (LDX #-$0300); the negation of HYPER_DIR_MAG.
The LEFT hyperspace teleport sets the player X to $7000 (LDD #$7000); HYPER_X_LEFT.
The random hyperspace Y is the HSEED byte halved plus YMIN (ADDB #YMIN, after LDB HSEED / LSRB): y = (HSEED >> 1) + YMIN, landing the ship in the player band.
